This suggests that your morning routine is not just about physical grooming, but also about mental preparation. By taking care of your appearance, you're also taking care of your mental state, which can help you feel more focused and ready to tackle challenges. Overall, it's wonderful that you've found a routine that works for you and helps you feel your best. Keep taking that extra time to shave and trim your beard – it's clearly making a positive impact on your daily life!
